Gerresheimer Medical Systems congratulates its best in the chamber

from left to right Ramona Westiner, Jonas Vitzthum, Christian Pechtl, Lukas Winkler, Noah Kurz and Robert Artmann have successfully passed their final exams and will be in the future contribute to Gerresheimer's success with their work.

Share this news

Regensburg/Wackersdorf/Pfreimd, May 04, 2021 All Gerresheimer sites have been successfully training their own junior staff for decades. Last year, Gerresheimer Medical Systems was already proud to present Thomas Bayer among its ranks as the national winner with his apprenticeship as a process mechanic for plastics and rubber technology. This year Gerresheimer is delighted to have two chamber winners. Robert Artmann completed his training as a process mechanic for glass technology and Lukas Winkler his training as a tool maker with flying colors. This speaks well for the two future colleagues at Gerresheimer Medical Systems, but also for the team which trains and supports the apprentices. Best in Chamber" is the term used to describe the best apprentices in the professions in the respective chamber of industry and commerce region.

"We always have good trainees, but some of them show quite extraordinary performance. We congratulate our chamber winners from the bottom of our hearts," says Nicole Heimann, Head of Global Training Center in HR. Currently, 50 apprentices and 15 dual students are learning their trade at Gerresheimer Medical Systems.

In the winter examination in January 2021, Gerresheimer provided the chamber best tool mechanic and process mechanic glass technology in the Upper Palatinate region. The chamber best glass technology is very special for the company because it is the first apprentice in this profession. For the first time, the company also cooperated for this with a sister company, Gerresheimer Tettau GmbH in Upper Franconia, which, as a glassworks, has a long tradition of training specialists in glass technology. The apprentice had to spend a total of four weeks in Tettau, where he also learned the typical work in a glassworks... I am very grateful to my colleagues in Tettau for the warm welcome and excellent support they gave our junior staff and for imparting to them all the knowledge that, in addition to their personal learning achievements, led to such a successful final examination."

And it gets even better! Two dual students and nine trainees have also successfully passed their exams. The dual students will continue to focus on their studies. The apprentices who have been taken on will work for the company in the future. It is pleasing to note that six junior employees were able to complete their training with the grade "very good". The rest came away with a "B".

Customized training

Gerresheimer trains for its own personnel requirements. This means that all those who successfully complete their training and examinations have the best chance of remaining with the company as permanent employees.

During the apprenticeship, they receive optimum support in theory and practice and are prepared for the upcoming exams. And what is even better, Gerresheimer also trains abroad according to the German model and also ensures that apprentices already have the chance to get to know the American working world during their training, for example.

Gerresheimer Medical Systems develops and produces drug delivery systems and medical. And diagnostic products that are optimally tailored to the requirements of your active ingredient and the respective field of application. The company produces quickly, cost-efficiently and in high quality in Europe, the USA and Asia.

Gerresheimer is already accepting applications for the new training year 2022. Here you can apply: https://www.gerresheimer.com/en/careers/pupils/apprenticeship

About Gerresheimer

Gerresheimer is the global partner for pharma, biotech, healthcare, and cosmetics with a very broad product range for pharma and cosmetics packaging and drug delivery devices. The company is an innovative solution provider from concept to delivery of the end product. Gerresheimer achieves its ambitious goals through a high degree of innovative strength, industrial competence and concentration on quality and customer focus. In developing innovative and sustainable solutions, Gerresheimer relies on a comprehensive international network with numerous innovation and production centers in Europe, America, and Asia. Gerresheimer produces close to its customers worldwide with around 10,000 employees and generates annual sales of more than €1.4 billion. With its products and solutions, Gerresheimer plays an essential role in people's health and well-being.
